author: Diego (research handoff, Fri 11:05 PM ET); claims extracted into JSON by Grok's pipeline from diego-research-1105.md

findings.claim: map.ts may store overlapping prisms in a cell as one base-to-top interval, which could seal walkable underpasses and create false LOS blocks.

sources.quote: a cell may represent overlapping prisms as one base-to-top interval

findings.suggested_change: Audit map.ts prism intervals; fix if underpasses are sealed (P0)

failure_classes.basis: false LOS would pick bad cover

findings.claim: nav.ts 2 m inflation may under-approximate the mech collision radius (nominal ~2.5 m, unverified), and cubes grow the mech.

sources.quote: A 2 m inflation may under-approximate a nominal 2.5 m collision radius

findings.suggested_change: Check inflation against hello.config collision size and cube growth (P0)

findings.claim: Path smoothing may cut corners even when grid cells are clear, including 3D clearance (bridges, roofs).
findings.suggested_change: Add nav unit scenarios for corners, alleys, bridges

findings.claim: Silent healing is not proven to help: the healing fire-gate variant (Build 5) scored worse, so any regen hold must allow emergency fire and be compared per encounter.

sources.quote: earlier experiment showed that a healing fire-gate variant scored worse

findings.suggested_change: Only test regen hold after cover selection works; keep emergency fire

findings.claim: A fixed laser+lightning preference should be tested against contextual weapon choice before replacing the baseline loadout globally.

sources.quote: Test contextual weapon loadouts against fixed laser+lightning preference

findings.suggested_change: P4: contextual loadout experiment, fixed order as control

findings.claim: Practice opponents are a coordinated, vision-sharing squad while final entrants compete independently, so practice-only exploits and fitting the 48 frozen seeds may not generalize to the final.

sources.quote: Practice bots are a coordinated, vision-sharing squad, while the final uses independently competing entrants

findings.suggested_change: Prefer mechanism changes; avoid practice-only exploits

findings.claim: The leaderboard gives only an aggregate score; without official per-match data a death cause must never be inferred from a single number.
findings.suggested_change: Record failure classes as suspected with confidence; instrument locally

findings.claim: Trees conceal vision but do not necessarily stop shots; cover scoring must distinguish concealment from hard cover.

sources.quote: Trees can conceal vision but do not necessarily stop shots

findings.suggested_change: Cover scoring counts only hard cover for shots

findings.claim: Vision is near-range 360-degree detection plus a forward field of view beyond it, and depends on torso aim rather than travel direction.

sources.quote: near-range 360-degree detection and forward FOV beyond it

findings.suggested_change: Read vision config from hello.config; use torso aim in sight-cone logic

findings.claim: Cubes grow the mech, which has collision and navigation consequences.

sources.quote: Account for cube stat benefits, size growth, collision/navigation consequences

findings.suggested_change: Scale nav inflation with cube count

findings.claim: A safe supply drop can deliver a powerful heal and cubes, but a contested capture can stall the mech.
Retreats that ignore threat geometry can run into overlapping attack lines from multiple enemies; routes should be scored by LOS exposure and shooter count.
Combat entry and exit should compare estimated time-to-kill with time-to-die (with margin and hysteresis) and abort when a second shooter appears.
